status.title: Your access status on this account

help.referenced: Referenced access: operational contacts and buyers come first. Nobody is removed, the list is only ordered differently.
help.to_build: Access to build: decision makers and sponsors come first. Nobody is removed, the list is only ordered differently.

help.inconnu: It is not yet known whether a rank-1 incumbent is in place on this account.

barrier.unmeasurableHelp: Below three measured indicators, no class is produced. “Not estimable” does not mean “open”.
barrier.absent: No barrier estimated for this account.
barrier.absentHelp: It is computed on every analysis, from the public registry. A dossier analysed before it existed does not carry one.

addressability.notMeasured: No axis could be measured for this account.

modes.title: Ways in
modes.help: Seven doors, five of them indirect. None is closed for lack of data: not knowing is not an obstacle.
modes.filiale_bu: Through a subsidiary or business unit
modes.rang2_soustraitance: Rank 2, under a firm already in place
modes.portage_marketplace: Through an umbrella company or marketplace
modes.cotraitance: Joint bid, with a lead contractor
modes.openDetailAria: View the detail of the "{{mode}}" route
modes.dialogDescription: This entry route's detail: how it usually plays out, who to talk to, and what to check next.

detailLabels.notRecommendedMissing: No route is currently discouraged in the catalog.

direct_reference.recommendedPath: Approach the buyer or IT department directly, leaning on your existing referencing — panel, framework agreement or live contract.
direct_reference.prerequisite: Already be referenced on this account (panel, framework agreement or active public contract).
direct_reference.firstPerson: The buyer or business sponsor managing the current referencing.
direct_reference.questionToAsk: What is the next tender or order wave under this referencing?
direct_reference.nextCondition: Get a date or scope for the next consultation.
direct_reference.fallback: If the referencing stalls, check whether it is still active or explore an off-panel direct entry.
direct_reference.notRecommended: If the need is not something IT or the referenced buyer handles, this route does not apply.

direct_hors_panel.recommendedPath: Approach a business sponsor directly, outside the referenced buying process, on a one-off or urgent need.
direct_hors_panel.prerequisite: A real need not covered by the panel already in place — a measurable pain point.
direct_hors_panel.firstPerson: An operational manager facing the need, rather than the buyer.
direct_hors_panel.questionToAsk: Can this need be handled outside the usual buying process, directly?
direct_hors_panel.nextCondition: Get this sponsor to validate a possible exception or direct purchase.
direct_hors_panel.fallback: If the buying process requires the panel, switch to entering through a subsidiary or an introduction.

filiale_bu.recommendedPath: Enter through a subsidiary or business unit that is less locked than headquarters.
filiale_bu.prerequisite: An identified subsidiary whose lock status differs from the group's.
filiale_bu.firstPerson: This subsidiary's IT or procurement manager, not headquarters'.
filiale_bu.questionToAsk: Does this subsidiary have its own budget and buying decision?
filiale_bu.nextCondition: Confirm the subsidiary's budget autonomy before investing sales time.
filiale_bu.fallback: If every known subsidiary routes back to headquarters, fall back to an introduction or a joint bid.
filiale_bu.notRecommended: If the targeted subsidiary has no budget or buying decision of its own, this route escalates to headquarters and loses its point.

rang2_soustraitance.recommendedPath: Position yourself as a subcontractor to a firm already in place on this account.
rang2_soustraitance.prerequisite: An identified tier-1 firm, with declared or observed openness to subcontracting.
rang2_soustraitance.firstPerson: That firm's account or delivery manager.
rang2_soustraitance.questionToAsk: Do you have a workload spike or a skill gap on this account?
rang2_soustraitance.nextCondition: Get a precise subcontracting need, with a scope and a volume.
rang2_soustraitance.fallback: If the incumbent firm is not open to tier 2, look for another incumbent firm or a direct entry.

portage_marketplace.recommendedPath: Go through an umbrella company or marketplace already referenced on this account.
portage_marketplace.prerequisite: An identified umbrella partner, active on this account or sector.
portage_marketplace.firstPerson: The umbrella partner's or marketplace's contact for this account.
portage_marketplace.questionToAsk: Which profiles or assignments does this partner already place on this account?
portage_marketplace.nextCondition: Be registered or referenced with the partner for this specific account.
portage_marketplace.fallback: If no active umbrella partner is identified, explore a joint bid or an introduction.

cotraitance.recommendedPath: Answer a tender jointly, alongside a lead partner already legitimate on this account.
cotraitance.prerequisite: An identified lead partner, in a position to carry the bid, with a genuinely complementary offer.
cotraitance.firstPerson: The prospective lead partner's manager or bid owner.
cotraitance.questionToAsk: Are you looking for a co-bidder on this account's next tenders?
cotraitance.nextCondition: Formalise the joint-bid agreement before the tender is published.
cotraitance.fallback: Without a willing lead partner, fall back to a direct off-panel entry or an introduction.

introduction_relation.recommendedPath: Go through an existing relationship — personal, a colleague's, or a past one — to get introduced.
introduction_relation.prerequisite: An active or reactivatable relationship with someone on the client side (CRM, history, team network).
introduction_relation.firstPerson: Whoever holds the relationship — you or a colleague, never named if not visible to you.
introduction_relation.questionToAsk: Is this relationship willing to make an introduction, and to whom?
introduction_relation.nextCondition: Get an actual introduction to a contact on the client side.
introduction_relation.fallback: If the relationship cannot introduce you, look for a direct entry or one through a subsidiary.
